name: B10-0100/2025 (The Left) – Recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent dismissals and arrests of mayors in Türkiye
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking Turkish authorities to stop removing elected mayors and replacing them with appointed officials. It asks for the release of jailed mayors and other detained people, including journalists and activists. It also calls on Turkey to make its laws on terrorism, assembly and disinformation meet international standards, and asks the Council to make rule of law a core part of EU–Turkey relations.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states demands to Turkey.
- Affects removed mayors, detained activists and voters in Kurdish areas.
- Next: the resolution is sent to EU institutions and Turkish authorities.
